Q: MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE not working on Android TV? A:

Since there is no answer for a month, I will answer my question.

After testing on multiple versions of Android TV in emulator, I found that MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is only available in Android TV 13 to 16, not in Android TV 11 and 12.

Q: How to remove the line breaks that Visual Studio Code includes when saving the code A:

If you are using Preiiter, then do this:

Open the settings.json by pressing and holding Command + Shift + P on Mac or Ctrl + Shift + P on windows:

Now add the following lines in `settings.json'

  "prettier.printWidth": 10000,
  "bladeFormatter.format.wrapLineLength": 10000,
  "html.format.wrapLineLength": 10000,

If you are not sure of using Prettier or other extension then press Command + , on Mac or Ctrl + , on windows and then copy and paste this text Print Width or Wrap Line Length when found adjust the value like 10000.

Hope this helps.

Q: Tomcat with https not working A:

In your server.xml file you have configured port 8443 for ssl

     <Connector SSLEnabled="true" acceptCount="100"
 clientAuth="false" disableUploadTimeout="true" enableLookups="false"
     keystoreFile="C:/Program Files/Java/jre1.8.0_91/bin/keystore" keystorePass="abcef" maxThreads="25" port="8443" protocol="org.apache.coyote.http11.Http11NioProtocol" 
    scheme="https" secure="true" sslProtocol="TLS"/>

But you are taking the URL with 8080 port https://hostedurl:8080 .

Q: How do I add a new solution to my team project? A:

To add a new solution from you local files to TFS you could:

In the solution explorer right click on the solution and select 'Add Solution to Source Control'

Then you can right click and select check in.

Then the entire solution will be added to your team project in TFS.
